ftbquests.chapter.4BDEBF50C7C261E2.quest: This mod will add many new hostile creatures that will make your game even more interesting.
Although the monsters are quite challenging, you will receive a worthy reward from them, which will allow you to create even more powerful equipment!
This mod wont't allow you to sit in one place for a long time, because movement is life!.. Well, or in your case, the absence of unnecessary death.
The longer you play, the more difficult the mobs become, so don't forget to upgrade your equipment!
The key mod of the modpack, which combines all its aspects!
Build your base, automate production, create powerful equipment and much more.
Are you already equipped so much that ordinary monsters do not cause any problems? Or are you a fan of proving your skills? In any case, Cataclysm is definitely what you need
The mod adds a lot of bosses, as well as unique weapons and resources, which, by the way, you will need in any case to create the &n&dAlloyed Sphere of Eternity&r&r:)
The modpack also contains many mods for new generation and structures!
In many of them you can find quite expensive loot, which can be especially useful at the beginning.
In addition, to get to the &dEnd&r, you will have to find &n12 unique eyes&r in different dungeons scattered all over the world!

ftbquests.chapter.4D29048FC709F066.quest: The modpack contains a wide variety of equipment.
Some you can find, some you can get from bosses, and some you will have to craft..
Here I'll tell you about a few things that I highly recommend for a comfortable game, but do not forget that you can always go your own way!
Equipment
It's a very useful thing that will make your movement around the base and the world much easier!

Jetpacks come in different types. Starting with the copper backpack, which is fairly easy to craft but not very convenient to use, and ending with the netherite one, which is the most comfortable to use but also the most difficult to craft.
Jetpacks
Are you tired of fighting monsters hand-to-hand? Or is your sword not sharp enough?
In any case, guns will definitely come in handy. It's quite difficult to create, but it also gives a multiple advantage. Just what you need to shoot off waves of evil spirits!
Guns
Guns
I think they don't need any introduction. Beautiful, powerful, useful weapons, just what you need after defeating another boss!
Cataclysm weapons
Have you already developed and finally want to move freely and quickly around the world without any restrictions?
Well, I have something to offer you, but keep in mind that you'll have work hard for it!
Grapplin whisk
Well, of course, where would we be without them. Explore the world and find unique items that give you a variety of abilities!
And once you've developed your base enough, you'll even be able to produce &erelics experiense&r, which will help you level them up even faster!
Artifacts
Relics
Artifacts and relics
The build contains a lot of different armor, including more powerful tiers than netherite one. Many of the sets also have unique effects, so feel free to explore and try out different options!
Armor

ftbquests.chapter.66042C997ED8CFFC.quest: First of all, many crafts were added/changed/removed for the sake of balance and more interesting gameplay.
Some crafts use items from other mods, which allows you to tie the entire modpack into a single whole.
Crafts
Or rather, not rework, but its complete removal.
In this modpack you will no longer be able to repair your equipment using experience.
An alternative could become &n&dAlloyed Sphere of Eternity&r&r, which, when applied, makes the tool lose all ability to break at all.
It also can be useful in your future crafts..
Mending rework
Since there are many different ways to move around in the modpack, it was decided to make flying on elytras a little more difficult.
Instead of elytras, it is recommended to use alternative means of transportation, such as trains or jetpacks, to travel long distances.
Jetpack
Disabled fireworks
Instead of classic minimap the modpack includes an Antique atlas. To open atlas press &6hot key&r (as default [&6M&r]).
Antique atlas
The modpack also includes a more appropriate alternative to the classic zoom.
If you have a &nSpyglass&r in your inventory, pressing the &6hotkey&r (by default [&6С&r]) will immediatly use it.
For more interesting gameplay, we decided to add temperature mechanics, the &3Cold&r &cSweat&r mod!
It is quite easy to manage,but always keep this in mind when you are going for a travel.
Temperature
Sleep slightly heals the character and also removes negative effects from him!
Beds
Better sleep

ftbquests.chapter.create_new_horizons.qu: Like the modpack itself, this guidebook will not give you clear directions throughout the entire game.
Here you will learn the basic things necessary for your survival, but then you will have to learn everything yourself.
After all, it's much more &ointeresting&r this way, isn't it?
However, if you still have any questions or advice, feel free to ask them on our &9Discord&r server!
in a world where you are completely on your own..
